stories.title: Add correctUnbornMasterDefault and ensureLocalPullRebase to git.ts
stories.description: New exported functions in src/modules/git.ts per architecture D1-D3, built on WP1's runGit.
acceptanceCriteria: correctUnbornMasterDefault repoints HEAD from master to main only when current unborn branch is exactly master (D2)
correctUnbornMasterDefault leaves any other branch name untouched
ensureLocalPullRebase distinguishes unset-locally from explicit-local-false via --local --get (D3)
ensureLocalPullRebase never overwrites an explicit local false
stories.testEvidence: test/init-git-state.test.ts: correctUnbornMasterDefault and ensureLocalPullRebase suites, real git fixtures. Also caught and fixed during implementation: the initial version trusted the caller to only invoke correctUnbornMasterDefault on an unborn repo -- added an internal rev-parse --verify HEAD check so a BORN repo on master is never touched (would otherwise detach HEAD from master's history without moving commits). Covered by a dedicated test.

stories.title: Wire the new git-state block into runInit
stories.description: Replace init.ts's countUncommittedChanges dirty-check with an inspectGitRepository-driven block calling both new functions; make next-steps output state-aware for not-repository.
acceptanceCriteria: not-repository: no git mutation, next-steps includes exact git init -b main guidance (R4)
no-commits: correctUnbornMasterDefault and ensureLocalPullRebase both run
ready: existing uncommitted-changes confirm UX unchanged, ensureLocalPullRebase also runs
dry-run never triggers any git-state action
stories.testEvidence: test/init-git-state.test.ts's end-to-end real-git runInit test proves the full wire-up (unborn master->main correction + pull.rebase set, in one real init run). test/init.test.ts's 14 existing tests pass unmodified in behavior (git mock extended, not replaced).

stories.title: Add checkPullRebase to spell doctor
stories.description: New independent doctor check verifying the EFFECTIVE pull.rebase resolves to true; non-blocking warning otherwise (D4).
acceptanceCriteria: Passes when effective pull.rebase is true
Non-blocking warning (not a hard failure) when it isn't
stories.testEvidence: test/init-git-state.test.ts's checkPullRebase suite: passes on true, warns non-blocking on unset/explicit-false/outside-a-repo (4 real-fixture tests).

stories.title: Regression coverage: real-git fixtures for R2/R3/R5/R6 plus checkPullRebase
stories.description: New test/init-git-state.test.ts using test/helpers/git-fixture.ts; extend test/init.test.ts's git mock factory to include inspectGitRepository without breaking existing tests (R8).
acceptanceCriteria: All existing test/init.test.ts assertions pass unmodified in behavior
New fixtures prove R2, R3, R5, R6 against real git
coverage on touched files meets the 80% repo-standard threshold
stories.testEvidence: 12 new tests in test/init-git-state.test.ts, all real-git fixtures, no mocking of src/modules/git.js in that file. Extending the git mock in test/init.test.ts surfaced a pre-existing latent issue (also present, separately, in test/update.test.ts, test/hub-retrofit.test.ts, test/session-continuity.test.ts): vi.restoreAllMocks() in several beforeEach blocks clears a plain vi.fn()'s configured resolved value, previously masked because the old code's numeric countUncommittedChanges > 0 comparison tolerated an undefined return silently -- the new code's gitState.status property access does not. Fixed in all four files by re-applying mock resolved values in beforeEach (matching the pattern already used for @inquirer/prompts mocks in two of them). Full suite: 488/489 passing (1 unrelated skip), lint clean, typecheck clean. Coverage src/modules/git.ts: 94.21% line / 96.29% branch.

Guidance text matches init.ts's next-steps wording for consistency

Self-host parity regenerated and verified clean.
